333.en: The northern lights are a spectacular natural phenomenon.
333.zh: 北极光是一种壮观的自然现象。

614.en: The experiment was designed to test the hypothesis.
614.zh: 这个实验是为了验证该假说而设计的。

617.en: Computer skills are now part of the school curriculum.
617.zh: 计算机技能现在是学校课程体系的一部分。

618.en: Tuition fees for overseas students rose again this year.
618.zh: 海外学生的学费今年再次上涨。

626.en: She is writing her thesis on renewable energy policy.
626.zh: 她正在写关于可再生能源政策的学位论文。

628.en: The lab is open to undergraduate students on weekdays.
628.zh: 实验室在工作日向本科生开放。

629.en: She is doing a postgraduate degree in linguistics.
629.zh: 她正在攻读语言学研究生学位。

633.en: The syllabus lists all the topics covered this term.
633.zh: 教学大纲列出了本学期的所有主题。

640.en: The dissertation must be handed in by the end of May.
640.zh: 毕业论文必须在五月底前提交。

645.zh: 这所大学使用软件检测抄袭。

662.zh: 在实验室里必须佩戴护目镜。

664.zh: 离开前请填写这份问卷。

666.en: Enrolment for evening classes closes on Friday.
666.zh: 晚间课程的注册周五截止。

668.en: New students attend an orientation week before lectures begin.
668.zh: 新生在开课前参加为期一周的迎新活动。

670.en: We discuss the week's reading in a small tutorial group.
670.zh: 我们在小型辅导课上讨论本周的阅读材料。

673.en: The opening ceremony will be held in the main auditorium.
673.zh: 开幕式将在大礼堂举行。

681.en: The canteen serves hot meals until eight in the evening.
681.zh: 食堂供应热餐直到晚上八点。

687.en: First-year students usually live in a dormitory on campus.
687.zh: 一年级学生通常住在校内宿舍。

690.en: You will receive a certificate on completing the course.
690.zh: 完成课程后你将获得一张证书。

694.en: He holds a diploma in graphic design.

704.en: The administration office handles all student records.
704.zh: 行政办公室管理所有学生档案。

706.en: The campus has excellent sports facilities.
706.zh: 校园里有一流的体育设施。

728.en: Set up the apparatus exactly as shown in the diagram.
728.zh: 严格按照图示安装仪器。

732.en: You must pay a deposit of one month's rent in advance.
732.zh: 你必须预付一个月房租作为押金。

733.en: You can get a full refund if you cancel within a week.
733.zh: 一周内取消可获得全额退款。

734.en: Keep the receipt in case you want to exchange the item.
734.zh: 保留收据以便日后换货。

749.en: Travel insurance covers lost luggage and medical costs.
749.zh: 旅行保险涵盖行李丢失和医疗费用。

751.en: The scholarship includes a monthly allowance for books.
751.zh: 奖学金包含每月的书籍津贴。

753.en: Plan a weekly budget to manage your living expenses.
753.zh: 制定每周预算来管理生活开支。

766.en: Accommodation is the biggest expense for most students.
766.zh: 住宿是大多数学生最大的开支。

802.en: Part-time work gives students a small extra income.
802.zh: 兼职工作给学生带来一小笔额外收入。

816.en: The job offers a good salary and long holidays.
816.zh: 这份工作薪水不错，假期也长。

826.en: The minimum wage was raised at the start of the year.
826.zh: 最低工资在年初上调了。

850.en: He retired early on a company pension.
850.zh: 他靠公司养老金提前退休了。

857.en: Students get a discount on rail travel with this card.
857.zh: 凭这张卡学生乘火车可享折扣。

879.en: The second-hand bike was a real bargain at thirty pounds.
879.zh: 这辆二手自行车才三十英镑，真是便宜。

886.en: The new centre offers a range of leisure activities.
886.zh: 新中心提供一系列休闲活动。

888.en: The venue for the concert has been changed to the city hall.
888.zh: 音乐会的场地已改到市政厅。

894.en: The itinerary includes two days of sightseeing in Rome.
894.zh: 行程表包括在罗马观光两天。

912.en: You can leave your luggage at the hotel reception.
912.zh: 你可以把行李寄存在酒店前台。

926.en: The clock tower is the most famous landmark in the town.
926.zh: 钟楼是这个镇最著名的地标。

934.en: She bought a small souvenir from every city she visited.
934.zh: 她在每个到访的城市都买了一件小纪念品。

965.en: The island has a mild climate all year round.

974.en: The drought destroyed most of the wheat harvest.
974.zh: 干旱毁掉了大部分小麦收成。

975.en: The flood forced hundreds of families to leave their homes.
975.zh: 洪水迫使数百户家庭离开家园。

986.en: The earthquake damaged several bridges in the region.
986.zh: 地震损坏了该地区的几座桥梁。

989.en: The volcano last erupted over a century ago.
989.zh: 这座火山上一次喷发是在一百多年前。

1022.en: The glacier has retreated two kilometres since 1950.
1022.zh: 自1950年以来，这条冰川已后退了两公里。

1048.en: The lighthouse stands at the tip of the peninsula.
1048.zh: 灯塔矗立在半岛的顶端。

1050.en: Africa is the second largest continent in the world.

1051.en: Winter in the southern hemisphere begins in June.
1051.zh: 南半球的冬天从六月开始。

1052.en: The climate varies greatly with latitude.
1052.zh: 气候随纬度不同而差异很大。

1056.en: Breathing becomes harder at high altitude.
1056.zh: 在高海拔地区呼吸会变得困难。

1057.en: The high humidity makes summer here feel hotter.
1057.zh: 高湿度让这里的夏天感觉更热。

1061.en: Dense vegetation covers the lower slopes of the mountain.
1061.zh: 茂密的植被覆盖着山的低坡。

1062.en: Logging is destroying the natural habitat of the orangutan.
1062.zh: 伐木正在破坏猩猩的自然栖息地。

1065.en: Several rare species live only on this island.
1065.zh: 有几种珍稀物种只生活在这座岛上。

1068.en: The owl is a silent predator that hunts at night.
1068.zh: 猫头鹰是夜间捕猎的无声捕食者。

1075.en: The cheetah relies on speed to catch its prey.

1078.en: The blue whale is the largest mammal on Earth.
1078.zh: 蓝鲸是地球上最大的哺乳动物。

1079.en: A reptile cannot control its body temperature internally.
1079.zh: 爬行动物无法从体内调节体温。

1080.en: Good nutrition is essential for children's growth.
1080.zh: 良好的营养对儿童成长至关重要。

1093.en: Beans are an excellent source of protein.
1093.zh: 豆类是极好的蛋白质来源。

1096.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C.

1099.en: Eating slowly is good for digestion.

1100.en: Regular sleep helps keep your immune system strong.
1100.zh: 规律的睡眠有助于保持免疫系统强健。

1129.en: The new vaccine protects against several types of flu.
1129.zh: 新疫苗可预防几种流感。

1140.en: A sore throat is often the first symptom of a cold.
1140.zh: 喉咙痛往往是感冒的最初症状。

1143.en: An early diagnosis greatly improves the chance of recovery.
1143.zh: 早期诊断能大大提高康复的机会。

1144.en: You need a prescription from a doctor for this medicine.
1144.zh: 这种药需要医生开处方才能买。

1152.zh: 校内药房营业到晚上九点。

1158.zh: 比赛后他的膝盖需要做个小手术。

1160.en: She made a full recovery within six weeks.
1160.zh: 她在六周内完全康复了。

1165.en: Hot lemon tea is a traditional remedy for a cold.
1165.zh: 热柠檬茶是治感冒的传统偏方。

1189.en: The flu epidemic closed schools across the region.
1189.zh: 流感疫情使全地区的学校停课。

1199.en: Good personal hygiene helps prevent infection.
1199.zh: 良好的个人卫生有助于预防感染。
